reducers.reduce_expiry_v1: Advance one accepted sequence; defer an intersecting held pin by appending only not-yet-pending targets in event order, otherwise expire present targets.

reducers.reduce_crash_reclaim_v3: Require exact held scope/owner/liveness/fence, false observed-owner-alive, expiry reached, and successorFencingToken exactly expected+1; apply complete ordered pending expiry, advance lastIssuedFencingToken exactly once, clear lease, and advance sequence.
reducers.reduce_resolve_and_pin_v2: Preserve exact RT13 idempotent retry; otherwise require current previous fence, future expiry, and every requested raw key AVAILABLE, then allocate exactly lastIssuedFencingToken+1.
reducers.is_retention_local_unavailable_v1: True exactly for a validated RETENTION_LOCAL_UNAVAILABLE result kind.

fixtureAlgorithm.input: Any finite nonempty topologically ordered record specification with any positive unit cardinality not exceeding record cardinality.
fixtureAlgorithm.recordBytes: Compact insertion-order UTF-8 JSON of the registered closed record; dependencies name only already-derived raw keys.
fixtureAlgorithm.proofRefs: One proof ref per byte-bearing record, sorted by the inherited RT13 encoded RawObjectKeyV1 bytes.
fixtureAlgorithm.units: Group every proof ref exactly once by declared capability and fixture unit label; derive UNIT-ID-V3 from the exact grouped raw keys; no count table exists.
fixtureAlgorithm.semanticClosure: Construct a complete SemanticCapabilityClosureV3 with byte-derived proof refs, graph, bindings, roots, units, and the inherited RT13 Merkle commitment grammar.
fixtureAlgorithm.operationalProjection: Derive OperationalCustodyProjectionV1 from the new closure using the generic count-independent projection algorithm.
fixtureAlgorithm.snapshot: Embed every exact raw byte vector keyed by its derived CAS; snapshot identity commits to the complete ordered byte map.
fixtureAlgorithm.forbidden: No fixture ref may equal an old RT13 NOMATCH proof ref and no identity-only row may terminate the closure.
